hypothesis: BTC and ETH show time-series momentum at 1-4 week horizons (Liu & Tsyvinski 2021): following the sign of the trailing L-day return for the next UTC day beats side-matched random twins on both assets.

data_choice: binance um klines-1m only; train block 2020-01 -> 2024-06.

rules.decision: the 23:59 UTC 1m bar s ((t+60) % 86400 == 0), UTC day D = t[s] // 86400; entry at the 00:00 open (s+1).
rules.signal: r_L = c[s] / c[a] - 1, a = the bar with t[a] == t[s] - L*86400 (the 23:59 bar L days earlier); no trade if a missing, s or a stale, or r_L == 0. side = sign(r_L). series='always_long' (report-only control): side = +1 on the same days.
rules.sd: sd (ddof 1) of the 30 daily log returns between consecutive 23:59-UTC closes of days D-30 .. D (31 closes, all present and > 0); known at the decision.
rules.bracket: stop = target = max(sd, floor_pct/100) * c[s]; time exit hold_s = 86280 s after entry (through the 23:57 bar), one trade at a time (engine).

count_check: signals only, count-only train look; configs under 200 non-overlapping on BTC or ETH dropped, not replaced.
expected_sign: positive mean net R on BTC and ETH; both legs positive or the short leg not negative.
against_the_mechanism: Report the long and short legs separately (from the gated run's trade files). If the long leg alone carries it, that is drift, not momentum.
Report only (not gated, not in the budget): always-long control with the same days, bracket and exit.
